title: What couples argue about most (and the fix)

slides.title: What couples *argue about most*
slides.sub: And the fix for each round.

slides.title: *Chores*
slides.body: The fix: split by preference, not by keeping score.

slides.title: *Money*
slides.body: The fix: one calm money talk a month.

slides.title: *Phones*
slides.body: The fix: phone-free zones, like the dinner table.

slides.title: *Family*
slides.body: The fix: you handle yours, I handle mine.

slides.title: *Time together*
slides.body: The fix: one protected night a week.

slides.title: *Where to eat*
slides.body: The fix: the one asking gives three options.

slides.title: Save this *and end round one early.*
slides.sub: Nobody wins a fight. Teams win fights.
